quests.title: Hilichurl Justice

dialogue.t: Mimi tomo, mimi mosi mita, Muhe mita?
Mita...? Gusha... Dada ika odomu Plata mimi, mimi mosi gusha...
Mimi tomo, mimi plata yaya ika! Mimi mani ye!
Mani...? Dada! Kundala zido mi, mi dada, mimi tomo!
Seems they're really getting into their conversation...

dialogue.sit: That was a very smooth interaction indeed.

dialogue.t: It just isn't fond of talking. But I still managed to get the information we needed.
All we need to do is defeat its enemy. That's where you guys come in!
Kundala nye, mani dada, tomo dada!
Mimi muhe du, du ya Wei zido dala si.
Mi mito nye. Mi mito du, du ya mito Wei.
It directed us to this location. It said someone here will have seen it before.

quests.description: You prepare to help a bullied hilichurl to even the score together with Ella Musk. With any luck, this may lead you to some new clues…
